_comment: The four dashboards of backend guide section 8 (milestone 8.5), defined as
data rather than clicked together in a UI, so they are reviewed like code
and survive a backend change. Two are infrastructure metrics and two are
product-health metrics, which is the distinction the guide draws and the
reason the last two exist at all: they say whether the product is working,
The instruments are emitted by app/telemetry.py and exported over OTLP when
TIRO_OTEL_ENDPOINT is set. Panel queries are written in PromQL against an
OTLP-to-Prometheus collector, the common deployment; a different backend
keeps the same instruments and rewrites the query strings.
No panel groups by anything identifying. The API panel groups by route
template, never path, so a course or submission id can never become a
label, and nothing about a seat is a metric dimension anywhere.

dashboards.name: API latency
dashboards.budget: p95 under 150 ms for reads and 400 ms for writes, excluding AI calls (backend guide 2)

dashboards.name: Queue depth
dashboards.budget: depth should drain between deadline peaks; a rising floor means the worker is under-provisioned

dashboards.name: Recognition confidence
dashboards.budget: the low tail is the signal: a growing share under 0.5 means the reader is struggling with real handwriting

dashboards.name: Variant verification pass rate
dashboards.budget: a falling pass rate means generation or the prompts have drifted; flagged variants are never served, so this is a cost and authoring-burden signal, not a correctness one
